description: arXiv:2610.38694v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Packing a 3D volume into a token sequence is not merely long-sequence modeling. Once the volume is packed, sequence order no longer encodes the geometry of the sample---so a positional mechanism indexed by sequence position can learn the memory layout rather than the object. This is a general failure mode for attention over packed geometric data...
author: Amil Khan, Anantajit Subrahmanya, B. S. Manjunath
